notes.title: Sanity Loops is Released!
notes.content:
[p]It was a long path to be honest
With that 5 month we learn a lot we did a lot and now you can enjoy our product!
[/p][p]We implemented a lot / tested a lot, hope this bag of knowledge will help us in future games :)
Hope you will like it guys, we really wanna see how people react on our work![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Sanity Loops Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]We are glad to announce that our game is ready for release.

[b]On September 16, 2025, the game will be launched on the platform.[/b][/h3][h3]
We’ve put a lot of work into the game and added exciting mechanics to make the gameplay more diverse.[/h3][p][/p][h3]We don’t want to say too much — instead, [b]we’d love to see feedback from players[/b], as it will help us grow in the future.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Thank you all, and we hope you really enjoy it![/h3]

notes.title: Game Change Update
notes.content:
​This is game change update, we implemented a[b] lot of staff[/b], thank you everyone who recorded videos, [b]your suggestions just here![/b]

[list]
[*] Radio music
[*] Reworked main location
[*] Reworked last location (at home)
[*] Some translation fixes
[*] Light fixes
[*] Added some interesting references!
[*] Easter Eggs!!!​
[/list]

So everyone who already played, just [b]HIGHLY recommend to play again[/b], it's [b]different demo[/b] now, where you [b]experience more interesting things[/b]

Please add game to [b]Wishlist[/b], to do not skip full version!
When we have [b]1 week to release full game[/b], we will share [b]10 keys for free[/b], [i]but about this later :)[/i]

notes.title: User feedback update
notes.content:
So guys, from Youtube videos and user comments we made HUGE updates:

1. Ambient music, now depends on place, street, kiosk etc.
2. We added more jumpscares :))))) Want to add them to Full version, Demo was like about story etc.
3. Radio!!! Now you can listen to radio in kiosk, music is so great, believe me

This most important staff that was added, you can download and check it on steam!

notes.title: Weekend Update
notes.content:
[b]​We made a great progress on Sanity Loops[/b]
Based on user activity and recorded[i] videos on Youtube[/i], we made some [b]hotfixes[/b], such as:
[olist]
[*] [b]Improved Camera on low fps[/b]
[*] [b]Added gif tutorial how to interact with shop[/b]
[*] [b]Made generator quiz more interesting, hover items now more easy (it's good, because before buttons were so small)[/b]
[*] [b]Light fix on last scene, it's pretty important, thank you TmoniYT​ for support (You can find him on Youtube)[/b]
[*] [b]Improved mouse sensitivity (I am working on Mac, other teammates on Windows) - So we lost a lot of time why sensitivity on Windows is different, compare to MacOS, answer - no idea, unity just works like thisYoutube)[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed some textures, UVs to make game more optimized[/b]
[/olist]

So we did it, to make Demo more interesting, we will continue to improve that next week, so this [b]weekend was really cool[/b], we got a lot of feedback, and fixed a lot of [b]important staff[/b].

[b]Your support is a treasure![/b]

notes.title: Sanity Loops Demo is OUT
notes.content:
We glad to introduce Demo version to you! 

We worked a lot of time, and now, finally, it's on steam!
We are wishing to you great experience of Demo version, and add full game to wishlist, to do not miss release date!
